page.overview:
Who is Jimmy Peakes?

Jimmy Peakes (c. 1983) was a wizard and Gryffindor student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. He was chosen by Harry Potter as a Beater for the 1996-1997 Gryffindor Quidditch team. Together with Ritchie Coote, they replaced Jack Sloper and Andrew Kirke.

Jimmy started his education at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1994. Upon his arrival at Hogwarts, Jimmy was sorted into Gryffindor House, a house renowned for bravery. He was three years below the famous Harry Potter.

In the 1996–1997 school year, Jimmy tried out and made it as the new Beater for the Gryffindor Quidditch team, replacing Fred and George Weasley with Ritchie Coote. Neither of them gave the team the same charisma, but were almost as good in game. He accidentally hit Harry, the team captain, with a Bludger during tryouts, giving the latter a swelling on his head the size of an egg.

Peakes stood up against Ron Weasley to defend teammate Demelza Robins after Ron shouted at her unexpectedly, causing her to cry following an accidental injury. During the Gryffindor versus Hufflepuff match, it was mentioned by Hermione Granger that he and Ritchie apparently caught Harry after he was knocked out by a Bludger to the head that Cormac McLaggen accidentally hit to him.
